targets.query: SELECT last("firmware") AS "Firmware", last("model") AS "Model", last("serial") AS "Serial nb", last("temp") AS "Temp", last("total_bytes") AS "Taille disque", last("used_bytes") AS "Utilisé" FROM "freebox" WHERE ("tag1" = 'Disque') AND $timeFilter

SELECT last("firmware") AS "Firmware", last("model") AS "Model", last("serial") AS "Serial nb", last("temp") AS "Temp", last("total_bytes") AS "Taille disque", last("used_bytes") AS "Utilisé", last("spinning") AS "Spinning" FROM "freebox" WHERE ("tag2" = 'dd-2') AND $timeFilter

SELECT last("firmware") AS "Firmware", last("model") AS "Model", last("serial") AS "Serial nb", last("temp") AS "Temp", last("total_bytes") AS "Taille disque", last("free_bytes") AS "Utilisé", last("spinning") AS "Spinning" FROM "freebox" WHERE ("tag2" = 'dd-3') AND $timeFilter

SELECT last("firmware") AS "Firmware", last("model") AS "Model", last("serial") AS "Serial nb", last("temp") AS "Temp", last("total_bytes") AS "Taille disque", last("used_bytes") AS "Utilisé", last("spinning") AS "Spinning" FROM "freebox" WHERE ("tag2" = 'dd-2') AND $timeFilter
SELECT "bytes_rate" *8/-1 AS "Rx" FROM "freebox" WHERE ("tag2" = 'Rx') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "tag1"
